dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the maximum width of the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel value across the dorsal surface with minimal tonal variation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, low-contrast linear markings (rake marks) on the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, parallel linear scarring visible on the posterior portion of the dorsal plane.
